criteria.pixels: Exact native RGBA comparison; display CSS sizing is excluded.
criteria.stages: Five real registered states per eye and jaw, distinct adjacent output pixels.
criteria.anchors: Every jaw patch keeps the registered upper-lip destination and uses equal-size translation only; this does not evaluate lip anatomy.
criteria.gaze: Center versus eight extreme inputs: no changed pixel outside the rasterized union of the current eye apertures; closed eyes remain identical.
criteria.legacy: Independent frozen family loaders and renderers, using the same named old states. New coefficient thresholds intentionally select additional states.
criteria.timing: Actual successful draw cadence; never RAF callback count, unique source count, camera inference, display presentation, or encoded video FPS.
criteria.visualApproval: Not evaluated. No approval/feedback is written.
